gloss: pleasure resort; holiday destination; tourist spot

definitions.gloss: pleasure resort; holiday destination; tourist spot
definitions.explanation: A place where people go for recreation, sightseeing, or leisure, especially during holidays and good weather.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{行楽地|こうらくち}。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}は{行楽地|こうらくち}がとても{混|こ}む。
examples.english: Tourist spots get very crowded during consecutive holidays.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{行楽地|こうらくち}として、{紅葉|こうよう}の{名所|めいしょ}が{毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}を{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: As autumn tourist destinations, famous spots for fall foliage attract many tourists every year.

notes:
Compound noun: {行楽|こうらく} (excursion, outing for pleasure) + {地|ち} (place). Often appears in news reports about holiday travel congestion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人気|にんき}の{行楽地|こうらくち} (popular tourist destination)
- {行楽地|こうらくち}が{賑|にぎ}わう (tourist spots bustling with visitors)
- {行楽|こうらく}シーズン (excursion season)
